services.name: Cannabis Association of New York (CANY)
services.description: Statewide industry association that says it represents the whole cannabis supply chain in New York, with members across the state.
services.eligibility: Membership is for cannabis businesses and companies that work with them; confirm terms with CANY.

coverage.value: CANY describes members stretching across New York State.

evidence.value: CANY says it represents the whole cannabis supply chain in New York and also serves businesses that work with the industry.
CANY posted an open letter to the Office of Cannabis Management dated February 26, 2026.

services.name: Empire State Green Standard Alliance
services.description: Statewide consumer advocacy group for New York cannabis consumers' rights and safety.
services.eligibility: Open to consumers who want to follow or join its advocacy; the site lists no direct phone or email.

coverage.value: The Alliance calls itself a statewide organization for New York's cannabis consumers.

evidence.value: The Alliance describes itself as a statewide organization working for the rights, safety and convenience of New York's cannabis consumers, with a November 2026 newsroom release.

services.name: The Bronx Cannabis Hub (a project of The Bronx Defenders)
services.description: Equity program for New Yorkers impacted by the state's marijuana laws who want to enter the legal industry, based in the Bronx.
services.eligibility: For people impacted by marijuana enforcement; cohort screening and terms are set by the Hub.

coverage.value: The Hub lists its office at 360 E 161st Street, The Bronx.

evidence.value: The Hub describes itself as an initiative for equitable inclusion of New Yorkers impacted by the state's marijuana laws, and publishes info@thebronxcannabishub.org.
